privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data.

dataCollection.title: 1. Data We Collect
dataCollection.content: We collect information when you register, including name, email, profile photo (via Google OAuth), location (if authorized), and site usage data.

dataUsage.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.content: We use your data to: provide and improve our services, personalize your experience, send event notifications, analyze site usage (Google Analytics), and comply with legal obligations.

dataSharing.title: 3. Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not sell your data. We share information only with: Google (authentication and analytics), Backblaze B2 (image storage), Sentry (error and performance monitoring), and when required by law.

dataRetention.title: 4. Data Retention
dataRetention.content: We keep your data while your account is active. You can request account deletion at any time.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights (GDPR)
rights.content: You have the right to: access your data, rectify incorrect information, delete your account, export your data, and withdraw previously given consents.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies
cookies.content: We use essential cookies (authentication, preferences) and analytics cookies (Google Analytics). You can manage your cookie preferences in settings.

security.title: 7. Security
security.content: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or destruction.

children.title: 8. Minors
children.content: Our services are not intended for individuals under 16 years old. If we discover we have collected data from a minor, we will delete it immediately.

internationalTransfers.title: 9. International Transfers
internationalTransfers.content: Your data may be transferred and stored on servers located outside the European Union. When this happens, we ensure that adequate safeguards are in place.

changes.title: 10. Policy Changes
changes.content: We may update this policy occasionally. We will notify you of significant changes.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.content: For privacy questions, contact us through the contact page.

items.noSell: We do not sell your data

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms

description.title: 2. Service Description
description.content: Athlifyr is a platform that aggregates information about sports events. We provide links to official event pages but do not organize or are responsible for the listed events.

account.title: 3. User Account
account.content: You must be at least 16 years old to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining your account security and all activities performed with it.

userContent.title: 4. User Content

prohibited.content: Prohibited: posting offensive, illegal content or content that violates third-party rights; using the service for spam or malicious activities; attempting to access restricted system areas.

intellectual.title: 6. Intellectual Property

disclaimer.title: 7. Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: The service is provided 'as is'. We do not guarantee the accuracy of event information. We are not responsible for cancellations, changes, or issues with listed events.

limitation.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
limitation.content: We will not be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from use of the service.

termination.title: 9. Suspension and Deletion
termination.content: We reserve the right to suspend or delete accounts that violate these terms, without prior notice.

changes.title: 10. Changes to Terms
changes.content: We may modify these terms at any time. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

law.title: 11. Applicable Law
law.content: These terms are governed by the laws of Portugal. Any dispute will be resolved in Portuguese courts.

contact.content: For questions about these terms, contact us through the contact page.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: We use cookies to improve your experience on Athlifyr. This page explains what cookies are and how we use them.

whatAre.title: What are Cookies?
whatAre.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the site to recognize you and remember your preferences.

essential.title: Essential Cookies (Required)
essential.description: Necessary for basic site functionality. Without these, the site does not work properly.
essential.examples: Authentication (login session), language preferences, cookie consent.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies (Optional)
analytics.description: Help us understand how visitors use the site to improve the experience.
analytics.examples: Google Analytics: pages visited, time on site, traffic source.

functional.title: Functional Cookies (Optional)
functional.examples: Event filter preferences, saved location, favorite sports.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.googleContent: We use Google Analytics, which places cookies on your device. Learn more in Google's privacy policy.
thirdParty.sentryContent: We also use Sentry for error and performance monitoring. Sentry may use local storage to record session replays when an error occurs. Learn more in Sentry's privacy policy.

manage.title: How to Manage Cookies
manage.banner: You can accept or reject non-essential cookies through our cookie banner.
manage.browser: Configure your browser to block cookies (may affect functionality).
manage.gaOptout: Use the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

duration.title: Cookie Duration
duration.session: Session Cookies: expire when you close your browser
duration.persistent: Persistent Cookies: remain on your device for a defined period (up to 365 days)

updates.title: Updates
updates.content: We may update this policy periodically. Check this page regularly to stay informed.

sentrySc.purpose: Sentry - session context for error monitoring

questions.content: If you have questions about cookies, contact us through the contact page.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.metaDescription: Learn about accessibility at Athlifyr, our current support, known limitations, and how to report accessibility issues.

intro.title: Our Commitment
intro.content: At Athlifyr, we believe sport is for everyone. We are committed to continuously improving the accessibility of our platforms so that all users, regardless of their abilities, can discover, participate in, and enjoy sports events and training.

items.language: Page language is correctly declared for all 6 supported languages
items.semanticHtml: Semantic HTML structure with proper landmarks (header, main, footer, navigation)
items.imageAlt: Meaningful alt text on content images
items.screenReader: Screen reader support with hidden labels and descriptive ARIA attributes
items.modals: Accessible dialogs with focus management and keyboard support
items.tabs: Tab components with proper ARIA roles and keyboard navigation
items.cookieConsent: Accessible cookie consent banner with labeled buttons
items.notifications: Toast notifications announced to screen readers
items.darkMode: Dark mode support for reduced eye strain

items.eventCards: Event cards with descriptive accessibility labels including title, date, and location
items.searchInput: Accessible search input with proper role and label
items.viewToggle: List/map view toggle with selected state announced to screen readers
items.translations: Accessibility labels translated across all supported languages
items.touchTargets: Touch target expansion on interactive elements

testing.title: How We Test Accessibility
testing.content: We use a combination of methods to evaluate and improve accessibility:

items.automated: Automated tools such as AccessMonitor and SonarQube for detecting WCAG violations
items.keyboard: Manual keyboard navigation testing across all main flows
items.codeReview: Code-level review of ARIA attributes, semantic HTML, and heading structure
items.wcag: Evaluation against WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines

limitations.title: Known Limitations
limitations.content: We are transparent about areas where accessibility may still be limited:

items.maps: Interactive maps (Mapbox) have limited screen reader and keyboard support. We are exploring text-based alternatives.
items.colorContrast: Color contrast has not been fully verified across all components. We are progressively auditing and correcting.
items.formErrors: Some form error messages are not yet programmatically linked to their input fields.
items.loadingStates: Some loading states are not announced to screen readers.
items.mobileLabels: Some mobile screens and interactive elements are still missing accessibility labels.
items.textScaling: Dynamic text scaling on mobile is not yet fully supported.
items.thirdParty: Third-party embedded content (maps, analytics) may not fully meet accessibility standards.

contact.title: Report an Accessibility Issue
contact.content: If you encounter an accessibility barrier or have suggestions for improvement, please contact us:
contact.subject: Accessibility Issue
contact.responseTime: We aim to respond within 5 business days.

standards.title: Standards We Follow
standards.content: We aim to follow the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA where applicable. We are continuously working to improve compliance across all platforms.
standards.note: Athlifyr does not claim full WCAG 2.1 compliance. We are actively working to identify and address accessibility gaps.
